summary.text: Lindsay Vaughn is a Democratic member of the Kansas House of Representatives representing District 22 (Johnson County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the House since 2021.
Lindsay Vaughn is listed as the ranking minority member of the Water Committee.

paragraphs.text: Lindsay Vaughn is listed as a member of the Water Committee, the Judiciary Committee and the Transportation Committee.
The Legislature lists Lindsay Vaughn's occupation as Volunteer Manager.
